cohort: The study participants were women who gave birth at the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department of the RSUP Dr. M. Djamil Padang, network hospital, and Puskesmas in Padang City, West Sumatra.
finding: There was a significant correlation between normal delivery methods and vacuum extraction with postpartum stress urinary incontinence.
mod_finding: A correlation was found between normal delivery and vacuum extraction and postpartum stress urinary incontinence.
